Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
garou wrote:
>
> Card text : "Whenever you play a card, you may draw its replacement from
> your's prey's library instead of your own. Put the card..."
> The card reafears when the Vampire plays a card or when the Mathuselah when
> this vamp is ready?

"you" refers to the controller of the card - the Methuselah.
"Ready" is not listed as a requirement on Agaitas's card text - the ability
functions as long as he's controlled.

> For exemple: when I play a master card that doesn't involve the vamp but i
> have him into play ?

Sure.

> or when this vamp plays a auspex intercept?

Also good.
